{{recipe|Brownies, Cake}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

These '''cake brownies''' are somewhat less dense and almost [[Cookbook:Cake|cake]]-like compared to ready-made mixtures one would buy from a store.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (6 ¾ [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 2.4 [[Cookbook:Deciliter|dl]]) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ½ cup (4 ¼ oz / 120 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Cocoa|cocoa]]
* ¾ cup (6 ¼oz / 180 g / 1.8 dl) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
* ½ cup (4 ¼ oz / 120 g / 1.2 dl) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]] or other nuts (optional)

== Procedure ==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9 x 9 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (23 x 23 cm) square [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]].
# [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] eggs until light in a medium-sized bowl.
# Add sugar, melted butter, and cocoa. Mix well.
# Add flour, salt, baking powder, vanilla, and nuts. Mix well with a rubber spatula.
# Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350 °F/175 °C (Gas Mark 4).
# Cool.
